text: Ironvale Athletic launch a swift counter-attack from their own left side of the pitch near the defensive third. Jonah Lindgren intercepts the ball around 19 metres from his own goal, then passes it forward to Aiden Morales in the central middle of the field. Morales quickly sets up Teo Quinlan on the right flank, who pushes forward and sends a through ball into space just inside the final third on the right side. Jonah Lindqvist receives the pass about 8 metres from the Redmond Rovers’ goal at the left edge of the penalty area, carries the ball forward with control, and fires a shot with his foot into the near corner, scoring and putting Ironvale Athletic ahead 1-0, leveling the match early [#40] [#41] [#42] [#45] [#46] [#50].
